mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 fails to rise in a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0% in a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) above 5-year averages signals economic expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies exceed thresholds in a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% in a 2-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% during a late-cycle expansion predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when FEDFUNDS <1% in late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of rising demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) above thresholds suggests economic strength, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when both proxies meet thresholds in a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 6.0% signals labor market stress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 6% in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and strong quarterly demand (GDPC1 above 5-year avg) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both conditions are met in a 1-year period.
